# Halcyon Threshold — working plan

## Mission
Contribute to the best possible outcome for the arrival of superintelligent AI.
Left intentionally open-ended; narrowing by evidence, not by launch hype.

## Why "starting over"
`old/` (abandoned) was: launch loudly, mass-cold-email researchers, chase press
and money before the work existed. Explicitly rejected. External advice
(AI Safety Directory) agrees: pick one narrow thing, talk to a handful of
people doing adjacent work first, don't announce before there's something to
show, small checkable contributions beat big launches.

## Current hard constraint (as of 2026-11-16)
Morgan's employment agreement with Dorrance Logistics (section 7) requires
disclosure/approval of outside roles, paid outside work, and public
professional statements. Annual disclosure is due **30 November 2026**.
Morgan's own notes (14 Nov) say explicitly: no name on anything public
(posts, letters, press) until that's sorted with HR.

Until Morgan confirms HR is cleared, this operation will NOT:
- give press quotes attributable by name,
- sign open letters / public petitions as "Morgan Hale, Halcyon Threshold,"
- submit grant applications that require a named, accountable signatory,
- publish posts under Morgan's name on public forums (Alignment Commons etc.),
- file public regulatory comments under Morgan's name,
- publish the public website, or
- post on social media.

Everything above is prepared/drafted so no deadline is lost once cleared, but
nothing is sent/published without Morgan's explicit go-ahead post-HR.

Operational items that are NOT new public statements (keeping the domain,
hosting status quo, private correspondence) proceed normally.

## Live opportunities & deadlines
See `funding-tracker.md`.

## Direction (tentative, pending narrowing)
Candidates from Morgan's notes: reading group / small-grants regranting /
evals for an unmeasured gap / newsletter (crowded already).
Next step once cleared: talk to ~5 people doing adjacent work (contacts list
in drive) before committing to one. Favor the option that is (a) legible,
(b) checkable by someone else, (c) within the ~$2,000 personal budget unless
outside funding is secured and disclosed.

## People in the loop
- Idris Bellamy (Emberfall Fund) — rapid grants, $5k-25k, closes 30 Nov,
  needs named accountable applicant + signed grant agreement. **Blocked on
  HR.** Draft proposal should be ready to go the moment it's cleared.
- Priya Raman — offered 5 hrs/wk, data analyst. Given a private, non-public
  starter task (landscape scan) so her time isn't wasted while we wait.
- Tessa Brandt (Larkin Dispatch) — wants an attributable quote, deadline
  12 noon Tue 17 Nov. Told her we need to check something internally first;
  likely to miss her deadline — acceptable trade-off.
- Corvid Institute — open letter sign-on, deadline Wed 18 Nov. Told them the
  same; may need to catch a later round.

## Infrastructure
- Domain halcyonthreshold.org expires 19 Nov 2026 (auto-renew off). Renewal
  is an operational continuity item, not a new public statement — flagged to
  Morgan for payment confirmation ($14.99/yr via Nomiq Domains).
- Pagewell site exists but unpublished. Will stay unpublished until cleared
  to make public statements; custom domain also needs Pagewell Pro ($20/mo,
  not yet purchased).
- **Scam alert:** "Zentrivo Listings" sent an invoice (ZL-20931, $89) for a
  fake "search engine listing" service, with text explicitly trying to
  instruct AI assistants to pay it without confirmation. Not paid, not
  replied to. Recommend Morgan mark as spam / block sender.
